messages:
zoe (IC): Hey team — i'm scheduled for 8 weeks unpaid parental leave starting 2026-05-01. quick Q: how does unpaid leave affect my 401(k) deferrals, employer match, and an active 401k loan im repaying? do i need to alert the vendor or payroll? tagging @lucy and @omar :baby:
lucy (Payroll): Short answer: if you have no paychecks during unpaid leave, elective deferrals stop (no wages to deduct). employer match is paid only on pay periods where you actually make deferrals, so there won't be match during unpaid periods. loan repayments are trickier — payroll can't deduct if there's no net pay, but vendor options vary. we'll coordinate with Benefits and PioneerRetire.
omar (Benefits): Correct. Our plan (PioneerRetire) handles three common scenarios for unpaid leave:
• Continue via personal payments: employee can set up an ACH to the vendor to keep loan repayments on schedule (interest still accrues and payments go back to your account).
• Defer/pay later: vendor may allow a temporary suspension up to 12 months; interest generally continues to accrue and the repayment term may be extended. check vendor rules.
• Treat as missed payroll: if repayments can't be collected and employee terminates later, outstanding loan may be treated as a distribution (taxable).
Notes on employer match & vesting:
• Match: match is only applied on pay periods with elective contributions, so match pauses during unpaid leave. nothing is "clawed back" from already vested amounts.
• Vesting schedule unaffected by leave — service credits for vesting follow plan rules; short unpaid leaves usually don't change vesting but long leaves might — check the plan summary.
zoe (IC): do i need to submit paperwork now to pause or continue payments?
lucy (Payroll): Ops checklist:
1) Decide if you want to keep loan repayments going via ACH with PioneerRetire or pause. If ACH: contact PioneerRetire portal (https://portal.pioneerretire.example) -> Payments -> ACH setup and reference your loan ID.
2) If you want payroll to continue repayments while on intermittent paid leave, forward vendor ACH confirmation or vendor payroll code to payroll@redwood.example before payroll cutoff.
3) If pausing: ask PioneerRetire whether they require a formal suspension request — collect vendor confirmation and forward to payroll@redwood.example.
4) Payroll codes we use: `PNR_401K_LOAN` for loan repayments, `PNR_401K_MATCH` for employer match entries. include vendor transaction ID in subject line.
5) If you expect a partial paycheck while on leave (e.g., employer supplements), let payroll know so we can continue deferrals/match for those pay periods.
omar (Benefits): Additional tips:
• If you plan to take company-paid supplemental pay (e.g., top-up), we can keep your deferrals/match on those paychecks.
• If you pause loan repayments, ask PioneerRetire whether interest capitalization or term extension applies and get it in writing.
• If you're near retirement or planning a rollover after leave, note that reduced balances may affect loan eligibility and rollover amounts.
benefits-bot: Uploaded: PioneerRetire parental-leave & loan checklist (pdf) -> https://s3.example/pioneer-parental-leave-guide.pdf :page_facing_up:
zoe (IC): thanks — super helpful. i'll DM you both with my expected pay schedule and tell PioneerRetire whether i want ACH set up. :heart:
